_comment: Milestone 2-A (REAL Kubernetes, Kind). Measurement parameters are identical to Milestone 1 baseline.json except where k8s forces a difference (see README 'Deviations from M1').

probe.note: These values are rendered into the Deployment manifests (kubelet probes). timeoutSeconds is an integer >=1 in Kubernetes (M1 simulation used 0.8 s).

scenario_params.dep_downtime_s: not a parameter on Kubernetes: downtime is whatever delete->recreate->start->WAL-replay takes
